description: This file defines a PHP class 'UserEntity' that implements the 'UserEntityInterface' from the OAuth2 server package. The class encapsulates a user identifier and provides a method to retrieve it, serving as an entity representation within an OAuth2 authentication context.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: An implementation of OAuth2 UserEntityInterface that holds a user identifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UserEntity with a user ID.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with this entity.
